description.p: Fang is a Wayland-first file manager for Linux built with Qt Quick. It ships a fast default UI — tabs, split view, four view modes, threaded file operations with undo, trash, search and image thumbnails — and lets you replace the entire view layer with your own QML while a stable controller API does the heavy lifting.

ul.li: Icons, list, details and tree views with type-to-filter
Threaded copy/move/trash with conflict handling and multi-level undo
Recursive search with optional content matching
Custom context-menu actions and full TOML theming
